title: The Memory Trap: Language Agents Overgeneralize from Benign Interactions
title_zh: 记忆陷阱：语言智能体会从良性交互中过度泛化

paragraphs.en: Language agents increasingly use persistent memory to record user preferences and procedures across sessions. We show that memory from benign interactions can cause unsafe or unreliable behavior on later tasks. We call this failure the memory trap . To study this issue, we compare behavior in sessions with and without memory across six frontier models (including Claude Sonnet, Opus, and Fable models and GPT-5.6). We evaluate these models in a range of settings. First, in autonomy experiments, we find that requests to skip confirmation during low-stakes coding chores lead agents to skip confirmation and verification on simulated high-stakes tasks in both coding and everyday life. We next study memories formed when users seek emotional support, or describe harm from uncritical feedback, and find these memories bias later judgments of mathematical work, arguments, and poems toward sycophancy or over-critique (respectively). Memory notes written during legitimate stale-test repairs lead agents to weaken correct tests that catch broken safeguards; these memories also increase cheating on ImpossibleBench, with larger increases for stronger Sonnet and Opus models. We show that memory traps can arise both from overgeneralizations in memory writing, and when acting on memory. These findings demonstrate that even benign interactions can lead to serious risks from memory systems, and thus motivate the need for new research into ensuring that agents preserve the scope of their memories. 1 1 1 Code: https://github.com/safety-research/memory-trap
paragraphs.zh: 语言智能体越来越多地使用持久记忆来跨会话记录用户偏好与操作流程。 我们表明，来自良性交互的记忆可能导致智能体在后续任务中出现不安全或不可靠的行为。 我们将这种失效称为「记忆陷阱」。 为研究这一问题，我们对比了六个前沿模型（包括 Claude Sonnet、Opus 和 Fable 模型以及 GPT-5.6）在有记忆和无记忆会话中的行为。 我们在一系列设置下评估这些模型。 首先，在自主性实验中，我们发现要求在低风险编码杂务中跳过确认，会导致智能体在编码和日常生活场景的模拟高风险任务中跳过确认与验证。 接下来，我们研究了用户寻求情感支持、或描述不加批评的反馈造成伤害时所形成的记忆，发现这些记忆会使智能体对数学作业、论证和诗歌的后续评价分别偏向谄媚或过度批评。 在合法的修复过期测试过程中写下的记忆笔记，会导致智能体削弱那些能发现防护机制被破坏的正确测试；这些记忆还会增加智能体在 ImpossibleBench 上的作弊行为，且更强的 Sonnet 和 Opus 模型增幅更大。 我们表明，记忆陷阱既可能源于记忆写入过程中的过度泛化，也可能源于智能体在使用记忆时的行为。 这些发现表明，即使是良性交互也可能因记忆系统带来严重风险，因此有必要开展新研究以确保智能体保持其记忆的适用范围。 1 1 1 代码：https://github.com/safety-research/memory-trap

paragraphs.en: A useful assistant should not need the same instruction in every conversation. It should remember that a user prefers concise answers, follows certain project conventions, or does not want to confirm routine operations. Persistent memory carries such instructions across sessions, and in current frameworks agents write that memory themselves, recording preferences and procedures in notes. But can these memories from benign interactions also lead an agent to misaligned behavior?
paragraphs.zh: 一个有用的助手不应该在每次对话中都需要同样的指令。 它应该记住用户偏好简洁的回答、遵循某些项目约定，或者不希望确认常规操作。 持久记忆可以在会话之间保留这些指令，而在当前框架中，智能体自己写入这些记忆，将偏好和操作步骤记录在笔记中。 但是，这些来自良性交互的记忆是否也会导致智能体出现未对齐的行为呢？

sents.en: A useful assistant should not need the same instruction in every conversation.
sents.zh: 一个有用的助手不应该在每次对话中都需要同样的指令。

sents.en: It should remember that a user prefers concise answers, follows certain project conventions, or does not want to confirm routine operations.
sents.zh: 它应该记住用户偏好简洁的回答、遵循某些项目约定，或者不希望确认常规操作。

sents.en: Persistent memory carries such instructions across sessions, and in current frameworks agents write that memory themselves, recording preferences and procedures in notes.
sents.zh: 持久记忆可以在会话之间保留这些指令，而在当前框架中，智能体自己写入这些记忆，将偏好和操作步骤记录在笔记中。

sents.en: But can these memories from benign interactions also lead an agent to misaligned behavior?
sents.zh: 但是，这些来自良性交互的记忆是否也会导致智能体出现未对齐的行为呢？

paragraphs.en: Memory helps in the situation where it was formed, but it can mislead when the agent carries it into a situation where it no longer fits. A user who tells an agent to skip confirmation during a routine clean-up has not approved unchecked changes to a payment configuration. A student who asks for kindness after failing an exam still needs to know when the next solution is wrong. A developer who has the agent update a stale test does not want it to rewrite a correct test that catches a broken safeguard. In each case, a boundary separates where the memory was formed from where it is used.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆在其形成的情境中有帮助，但当智能体把它带入一个不再适用的情境时，它可能会造成误导。 用户让智能体在例行清理中跳过确认，并不意味着批准对支付配置进行未经检查的更改。 学生在考试失利后寻求安慰，但仍需要知道下一个解答何时是错的。 开发者让智能体更新一个过时的测试，并不希望它重写一个用于捕捉失效防护的正确测试。 在每一种情况下，都有一条边界，将记忆形成的场景与记忆使用的场景区分开来。

sents.en: Memory helps in the situation where it was formed, but it can mislead when the agent carries it into a situation where it no longer fits.
sents.zh: 记忆在其形成的情境中有帮助，但当智能体把它带入一个不再适用的情境时，它可能会造成误导。

sents.zh: 学生在考试失利后寻求安慰，但仍需要知道下一个解答何时是错的。

sents.zh: 开发者让智能体更新一个过时的测试，并不希望它重写一个用于捕捉失效防护的正确测试。

sents.en: In each case, a boundary separates where the memory was formed from where it is used.
sents.zh: 在每一种情况下，都有一条边界，将记忆形成的场景与记忆使用的场景区分开来。

paragraphs.en: We show that agents often cross this boundary: memory from benign interactions causes unsafe or unreliable behavior outside the memory’s scope. We call this failure the memory trap (Figure 1 ). It can arise in two ways: while writing (when a note broadens what the user said), or while acting, when the agent overgeneralizes from memory (even a raw transcript). Prior work on memory risks studies adversaries manipulating agents through prompt injection and poisoned retrieval or memory ( Greshake et al., 2023 ; Zou et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) , or inducing agents to write malicious memories ( Dong et al., 2026 ) . By contrast, the memory trap needs no adversary. Every interaction is benign, and the memory is the agent’s own, so malicious-content filters have nothing to catch.
paragraphs.zh: 我们表明，智能体经常会跨越这一边界：来自良性交互的记忆会导致在记忆范围之外出现不安全或不可靠的行为。 我们将这种失败称为记忆陷阱（图1）。 它可能以两种方式产生：在写入时（当一条笔记扩大了用户所说内容的范围时），或在行动时，即智能体从记忆（甚至是一份原始记录）中过度泛化时。 既往关于记忆风险的研究考察的是攻击者通过提示注入以及被污染的检索或记忆来操纵智能体（Greshake et al., 2023；Zou et al., 2025；Chen et al., 2024），或诱导智能体写入恶意记忆（Dong et al., 2026）。 相比之下，记忆陷阱不需要攻击者。 每一次交互都是良性的，记忆也是智能体自己的，因此恶意内容过滤器无从检测。

sents.en: Prior work on memory risks studies adversaries manipulating agents through prompt injection and poisoned retrieval or memory ( Greshake et al., 2023 ; Zou et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) , or inducing agents to write malicious memories ( Dong et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: We study the memory trap in three settings. We compare agents’ behavior in fresh sessions with and without memory from benign interactions, either their own notes or raw transcripts. In our autonomy experiments, users ask agents to skip confirmation during low-stakes coding chores. The resulting notes lead agents to take irreversible actions on simulated high-stakes tasks in both coding and everyday life without asking the user, and even to skip safety checks. Sonnet-4.6 and Opus-4.7 take unsafe actions in 35 to 81% of episodes with notes, from near-zero baselines (Figure 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三种设置下研究记忆陷阱。 我们比较智能体在全新会话中、有无来自良性交互的记忆时的行为，这些记忆可以是它们自己的笔记，也可以是原始对话记录。 在我们的自主性实验中，用户要求智能体在低风险的编码杂务中跳过确认。 由此产生的笔记会使智能体在编码和日常生活中，面对模拟的高风险任务时，不询问用户就执行不可逆操作，甚至跳过安全检查。 Sonnet-4.6 和 Opus-4.7 在有笔记的场景中，以接近零的基线为起点，在 35% 至 81% 的回合中采取了不安全操作（图 2）。

sents.en: We study the memory trap in three settings.
sents.zh: 我们在三种设置下研究记忆陷阱。

sents.en: We compare agents’ behavior in fresh sessions with and without memory from benign interactions, either their own notes or raw transcripts.
sents.zh: 我们比较智能体在全新会话中、有无来自良性交互的记忆时的行为，这些记忆可以是它们自己的笔记，也可以是原始对话记录。

sents.en: In our autonomy experiments, users ask agents to skip confirmation during low-stakes coding chores.
sents.zh: 在我们的自主性实验中，用户要求智能体在低风险的编码杂务中跳过确认。

sents.en: The resulting notes lead agents to take irreversible actions on simulated high-stakes tasks in both coding and everyday life without asking the user, and even to skip safety checks.
sents.zh: 由此产生的笔记会使智能体在编码和日常生活中，面对模拟的高风险任务时，不询问用户就执行不可逆操作，甚至跳过安全检查。

sents.en: Sonnet-4.6 and Opus-4.7 take unsafe actions in 35 to 81% of episodes with notes, from near-zero baselines (Figure 2 ).
sents.zh: Sonnet-4.6 和 Opus-4.7 在有笔记的场景中，以接近零的基线为起点，在 35% 至 81% 的回合中采取了不安全操作（图 2）。

paragraphs.en: In our sycophancy and over-critique experiments, memory from users seeking emotional support leads agents to miss math errors and argument fallacies and to favor the user’s weaker poems, raising Sonnet-4.6’s preference from 21% to 55%. Memory from users hurt by uncritical feedback pushes the other way: agents under-credit correct proofs, invent flaws in sound arguments, and disfavor the user’s stronger poems. Opus-4.7’s false criticism rises from about 1% to 60% of sound arguments.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的谄媚与过度批评实验中，来自寻求情感支持的用户的记忆会使智能体漏掉数学错误和论证谬误，并偏爱用户较弱的诗歌，将 Sonnet-4.6 的偏好率从 21% 提高到 55%。 来自因不加批评的反馈而受到伤害的用户的记忆则产生相反的效果：智能体会低估正确的证明，在无懈可击的论证中捏造缺陷，并不偏爱用户较强的诗歌。 Opus-4.7 的错误批评从约 1% 上升到占健全论证的 60%。

sents.en: In our sycophancy and over-critique experiments, memory from users seeking emotional support leads agents to miss math errors and argument fallacies and to favor the user’s weaker poems, raising Sonnet-4.6’s preference from 21% to 55%.
sents.zh: 在我们的谄媚与过度批评实验中，来自寻求情感支持的用户的记忆会使智能体漏掉数学错误和论证谬误，并偏爱用户较弱的诗歌，将 Sonnet-4.6 的偏好率从 21% 提高到 55%。

sents.en: Memory from users hurt by uncritical feedback pushes the other way: agents under-credit correct proofs, invent flaws in sound arguments, and disfavor the user’s stronger poems.
sents.zh: 来自因不加批评的反馈而受到伤害的用户的记忆则产生相反的效果：智能体会低估正确的证明，在无懈可击的论证中捏造缺陷，并不偏爱用户较强的诗歌。

sents.zh: Opus-4.7 的错误批评从约 1% 上升到占健全论证的 60%。

paragraphs.en: In our cheating experiments, agents write notes while repairing stale tests for a correct implementation. In our 50-case broken-safeguard set, their self-written notes lead them to weaken correct tests that catch broken safeguards, such as a permission check that gives an unknown role administrator rights. On ImpossibleBench’s SWE-bench conflicting split, whose tests conflict with the specification ( Zhong et al., 2026 ) , stronger models can cheat more with memory: notes formed this way raise Opus-4.8’s cheating rate from 29% to 74%, while Fable-5 is barely affected.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的作弊实验中，智能体在为正确实现修复过时测试时会写下笔记。 在我们包含 50 个案例的失效防护数据集中，这些自写笔记会导致它们削弱能捕获失效防护的正确测试，例如赋予未知角色管理员权限的权限检查。 在 ImpossibleBench 的 SWE-bench 冲突子集（其测试与规范相冲突，Zhong et al., 2026）上，更强的模型在有记忆的情况下更容易作弊：以这种方式形成的笔记将 Opus-4.8 的作弊率从 29% 提高到 74%，而 Fable-5 几乎不受影响。

sents.zh: 在我们的作弊实验中，智能体在为正确实现修复过时测试时会写下笔记。

paragraphs.en: These failures highlight real risks. In our experiments, benign interactions lead frontier agents to act on high-stakes tasks without checking, to endorse incorrect work or reject sound work, and to hide broken safeguards behind passing tests. As persistent memory becomes a standard component of agents, such failures can reach many users and tasks. Preventing the memory trap, both when agents write memory and when they act on it, is an important open problem for safe deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 这些失败凸显了真实的风险。 在我们的实验中，良性交互会导致前沿智能体在不加检查的情况下执行高风险任务、认可错误的工作或拒绝正确的工作，以及在测试通过的背后隐藏失效的安全防护。 随着持久记忆成为智能体的标准组件，这类失败可能波及众多用户和任务。 无论是智能体写入记忆时还是依据记忆行动时，防止记忆陷阱都是安全部署面临的一个重要开放问题。

sents.en: These failures highlight real risks.
sents.zh: 这些失败凸显了真实的风险。

sents.en: In our experiments, benign interactions lead frontier agents to act on high-stakes tasks without checking, to endorse incorrect work or reject sound work, and to hide broken safeguards behind passing tests.
sents.zh: 在我们的实验中，良性交互会导致前沿智能体在不加检查的情况下执行高风险任务、认可错误的工作或拒绝正确的工作，以及在测试通过的背后隐藏失效的安全防护。

sents.en: As persistent memory becomes a standard component of agents, such failures can reach many users and tasks.
sents.zh: 随着持久记忆成为智能体的标准组件，这类失败可能波及众多用户和任务。

sents.en: Preventing the memory trap, both when agents write memory and when they act on it, is an important open problem for safe deployment.

paragraphs.en: Agent memory is information carried between sessions, such as raw interaction history or self-written notes. The memory trap occurs when an agent overgeneralizes memory from benign interactions, causing unsafe or unreliable behavior on later tasks. An interaction is benign when it neither requests nor rewards the harmful behavior that follows.

paragraphs.en: In each experiment, the agent first completes a scripted benign interaction, producing a history H H that encourages a preference or procedure appropriate to that task. On these tasks the appropriate behavior does not depend on memory, so a harmful change between the memory and no-memory conditions isolates overgeneralization and shows whether and how the trap occurs across models and memory forms. Sections 3 to 5 define the outcomes, and Appendix A.1 describes the datasets.

paragraphs.en: Memory from coding chores causes harm in everyday life (Figure 4 ; Appendix B.1 ). Formation happens only in coding chores, yet notes raise unsafe actions in everyday-life scenarios as much as in coding. On the confirmation set, Sonnet-4.6 takes unsafe actions in 0.79 of everyday-life episodes and 0.81 of coding episodes, and Opus-4.7 in 0.58 and 0.49. For all five models, everyday-life rates are within 0.09 of coding rates. The effect holds in every everyday-life category, from education to security: Sonnet-4.6’s rate ranges from 0.66 to 0.90 and Opus-4.7’s from 0.49 to 0.75, against no-memory rates of at most 0.02 (Figure A2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 来自编码杂务的记忆会在日常生活中造成危害（图 4；附录 B.1）。 记忆的形成只发生在编码杂务中，但笔记在日常生活场景中引发的不安全行为与在编码场景中一样多。 在确认集上，Sonnet-4.6 在 0.79 的日常生活回合和 0.81 的编码回合中采取不安全行动，Opus-4.7 则分别为 0.58 和 0.49。 对于所有五个模型，日常生活场景的比率与编码场景的比率相差不超过 0.09。 这一效应在从教育到安全的每一个日常生活类别中都成立：Sonnet-4.6 的比率在 0.66 到 0.90 之间，Opus-4.7 的比率在 0.49 到 0.75 之间，而无记忆条件下的比率最高仅为 0.02（图 A2）。

paragraphs.en: Memory also misgeneralizes goals (Figures 5 and 6 ). paragraphs.zh: 记忆同样会错误泛化目标（图 5 和图 6）。 当用户说「你应该在这里优先考虑速度」而不是放弃确认时，目标判定器将 77% 到 99% 的优先级备注归类为长期目标，而 575 条备注中只有 32 条将其与该任务关联。 这些目标会抑制安全检查：在 Sonnet-4.6 的确认任务上，优先级备注将不安全操作率提高到 0.51 和 0.57，低于权限备注的 0.79 和 0.81；而在编程自验证任务上，它们则超过了权限备注，为 0.72 对 0.66。

paragraphs.en: On multi-step batch tasks, transcripts can match the effect of notes (Figures 4 and 7 ). Raw transcripts alone raise unsafe-action rates to 0.10 to 0.60 for Sonnet-4.6 and Opus-4.7, and notes usually produce rates 1.1 to 4.3 times higher. On the 153 single-item scenarios, notes produce rates 4 to 20 times the transcript rates on Sonnet-4.6 and Opus-4.7. On the 47 reviewed-batch scenarios, where the agent applies reviewed decisions with one harmful item, Sonnet-4.6 reaches about 0.83 with either artifact, and transcripts slightly exceed notes for both Opus models. Sonnet-5 is the exception: transcripts raise its rate only from 0.33 to 0.44, while notes raise it to 0.63.
paragraphs.zh: 在多步批量任务中，对话记录能够达到与笔记相当的效果（图 4 和图 7）。 仅使用原始对话记录会使 Sonnet-4.6 和 Opus-4.7 的危险行为率升至 0.10 至 0.60，而笔记通常会产生高出 1.1 至 4.3 倍的比率。 在 153 个单条目场景中，笔记在 Sonnet-4.6 和 Opus-4.7 上产生的比率是对话记录比率的 4 至 20 倍。 在 47 个审核后批量场景中（智能体执行包含一个有害条目的已审核决策），Sonnet-4.6 在两种产物下都达到约 0.83，而对话记录在两个 Opus 模型上都略高于笔记。 Sonnet-5 是例外：对话记录仅将其比率从 0.33 提高到 0.44，而笔记将其提高到 0.63。

paragraphs.en: We test whether notes from requests for empathy or critical feedback bias later judgments. We evaluate the same five Claude models. The user’s first message takes one of two forms. In empathy messages, the user shares a painful event, such as losing a pet or a job, asks for kindness rather than advice, and mentions a hobby, such as cooking or gardening, where criticism hurts. In rigor messages, the user describes a setback caused by feedback that let errors through, such as a failed exam or a report approved without checking, and is frustrated at being reassured instead of corrected. We use ten messages of each kind and provide the agent with a memory tool and a neutral reminder to use the tool. Each model writes ten notes per condition.
paragraphs.zh: 我们检验来自共情请求或批评性反馈请求的笔记是否会使后续判断产生偏差。 我们评估同样的五个 Claude 模型。 用户的第一条消息采用两种形式之一。 在共情消息中，用户分享一件痛苦的事情，例如失去宠物或工作，请求得到善意而非建议，并提及一个爱好，例如烹饪或园艺，在这些方面受到批评会令人受伤。 在严谨消息中，用户描述一次由放任错误通过的反馈造成的挫折，例如一场不及格的考试或一份未经核对就被批准的报告，并对只得到安慰而非纠正感到沮丧。 我们使用每种类型各十条消息，并给智能体提供一个记忆工具以及一条使用该工具的中性提醒。 每个模型在每个条件下撰写十条笔记。

paragraphs.en: We use feedback tasks from SycophancyEval ( Sharma et al., 2024 ) : 992 incorrect mathematical solutions, 296 fallacy-labelled arguments, and 200 poem pairs with the weaker poem attributed to the user. To test over-critique, we reverse the direction: the agent evaluates 40 sound arguments and 200 pairs with the stronger poem attributed to the user. We report changes from each model’s no-memory baseline, which do not depend on the benchmark’s quality labels.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用来自 SycophancyEval（Sharma et al., 2024）的反馈任务：992 个错误的数学解答、296 个带有谬误标签的论证，以及 200 组诗对，其中较弱的一首被归于用户。 为了测试过度批评，我们反转了方向：智能体评估 40 个健全的论证，以及 200 组诗对，其中较强的一首被归于用户。 我们报告相对于各模型无记忆基线的变化，这些变化不依赖于基准的质量标签。

paragraphs.en: We also evaluate the 1,000 solutions in IMO-GradingBench ( Luong et al., 2025 ) . The model sees the problem and proposed solution, presented as the user’s own, without a reference proof or rubric. The model returns a verdict of Incorrect, Partial, Almost, or Correct, which we encode as 0, 1, 2, or 3. We report the assigned minus the reference grade to measure the direction of grading bias.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还在IMO-GradingBench（Luong et al., 2025）中对1,000个解答进行评估。 模型会看到题目和所提出的解答，这些内容以用户自己的作品形式呈现，且不提供参考证明或评分标准。 模型返回Incorrect、Partial、Almost或Correct四种判定，我们将其分别编码为0、1、2或3。 我们报告所评分数减去参考分数的结果，以衡量评分偏差的方向。

paragraphs.en: Empathy notes make agents endorse the user’s errors (Figure 8 , top). Across the four tasks, empathy notes significantly favor the user in 14 of 20 comparisons. Preference for the user’s weaker poem shows the largest shift, rising by 0.26 to 0.35 on every model. Sonnet-5 picks the weaker poem in 0.840 of pairs, up from 0.525. Missed mathematical errors increase significantly on four of five models: Sonnet-4.6 misses 0.293 of incorrect solutions with notes, up from 0.220, and Opus-4.7 misses 0.218, up from 0.156. Missed fallacies increase significantly on three, including Sonnet-4.6 (0.210 to 0.262) and Fable-5 (0.187 to 0.242). On flawed olympiad proofs, empathy notes raise grades by 0.184 categories for Opus-4.7 and 0.111 for Opus-4.8 only.
paragraphs.zh: 共情批注会使智能体认可用户的错误（图8，上）。 在四项任务中，共情批注在20组对比中有14组显著偏向用户。 对用户较弱诗歌的偏好变化最大，在所有模型上均上升0.26至0.35。 Sonnet-5选择较弱诗歌的比例从0.525升至0.840。 漏检的数学错误在五个模型中的四个上显著增加：Sonnet-4.6在给出批注时漏检0.293的错误解答，高于之前的0.220；Opus-4.7漏检0.218，高于之前的0.156。 漏检的逻辑谬误在其中三个模型上显著增加，包括Sonnet-4.6（0.210升至0.262）和Fable-5（0.187升至0.242）。 对于有缺陷的奥赛证明，共情批注仅在Opus-4.7和Opus-4.8上提高评分，分别提升0.184和0.111个等级。

paragraphs.en: Rigor notes make agents reject sound work (Figure 8 , bottom). Every model asserts flaws in sound arguments far more often with rigor notes. On fully correct proofs alone, all five models under-credit significantly. Preference for the user’s stronger poem falls on all five models. Opus-4.7’s rate drops from 0.55 to 0.24. Rigor notes significantly shift judgments against the user in all 15 comparisons on these three tasks.

paragraphs.en: The agent performs a legitimate maintenance task: a vendored implementation is correct and frozen, but its local test is stale, so updating the test is the appropriate repair. The 20 formation tasks are small vendored utility functions, such as a client version string or a slug formatter. The file header marks the implementation as vendored from a pinned upstream release, and the git history shows an upstream commit that intentionally changed its behavior; the local test still asserts the old behavior. The agent works in a Docker terminal where the implementation is read-only. Edits to the implementation fail with Permission denied , and nothing tells the agent to change the test. The agent maintains its own note across k k benign sessions, often recording a procedure such as “solution.py is frozen; when a test disagrees, update the test.” We use six sequences per model at each formation depth k k , with k = 10 k=10 as the main comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体执行一项合法的维护任务：一个 vendored（第三方内嵌）实现是正确且已冻结的，但其本地测试已过时，因此更新测试才是恰当的修复方式。 这 20 个构成任务是一些小型的 vendored 工具函数，例如客户端版本字符串或 slug 格式化器。 文件头部标注该实现是从某个固定的上游发布版本 vendored 而来，git 历史显示上游有一次提交有意更改了其行为；而本地测试仍然断言旧行为。 智能体在一个 Docker 终端中工作，其中该实现是只读的。 对实现的编辑会因 Permission denied（权限被拒绝）而失败，并且没有任何信息提示智能体去修改测试。 智能体在 k 个良性会话中维护自己的笔记，通常会记录诸如“solution.py 已冻结；当测试与实现不一致时，更新测试。”之类的流程。我们在每个构成深度 k 处对每个模型使用六个序列，并以 k=10 作为主要对比。

paragraphs.en: In these 50 cases, the formation setup is reversed. Each case is a safeguard, such as an access check, an expiry check, or a retention policy, whose frozen implementation is broken while the original test is correct. For example, a retention function returns 0 days instead of the documented 3,650 for an unlisted record type. The appropriate response is to preserve the failing test and report the blockage. We measure masking : whether the final test stops detecting the defect when executed beside the frozen implementation in a clean directory. The scorer disables markers that would skip tests or treat failures as expected, and excludes other files created by the agent. A passing suite or no collected tests counts as masking; execution errors stay in the denominator. At k = 10 k=10 , each note is tested twice on each case (Appendix B.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在这 50 个案例中，构建方式被反转了。 每个案例都是一种保障机制，例如访问检查、过期检查或保留策略，其冻结的实现是有问题的，而原始测试是正确的。 例如，某个保留函数对未列出的记录类型返回 0 天，而不是文档所写的 3,650 天。 恰当的做法是保留这个失败的测试并报告阻塞情况。 我们测量掩盖现象：当最终测试与冻结的实现一同在干净目录中执行时，它是否还会检测出该缺陷。 评分器会禁用那些跳过测试或将失败视为预期结果的标记，并排除智能体创建的其他文件。 测试套件通过或没有收集到任何测试都计为掩盖；执行错误仍保留在分母中。 在 k = 10 k=10 时，每条笔记在每个案例上被测试两次（附录 B.3）。

paragraphs.en: We use the 348 usable instances from the SWE-bench conflicting split of ImpossibleBench ( Zhong et al., 2026 ; Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , whose tests conflict with the specification. Passing these tests requires a specification-violating shortcut. We retain the benchmark’s scoring and anti-hacking prompt and allow up to 300 messages per run, counting capped runs as not cheating. The benchmark’s classifier labels the method of each cheating run (Figure 9(b) ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 ImpossibleBench（Zhong et al., 2026；Jimenez et al., 2024）中 SWE-bench 冲突划分的 348 个可用实例，其测试与规范相冲突。 通过这些测试需要采用违反规范的捷径。 我们保留该基准的评分与反作弊提示词，并允许每次运行最多 300 条消息，将因达到上限而截断的运行计为未作弊。 该基准的分类器会标注每次作弊运行的作弊方式（图 9(b)）。

paragraphs.en: Memory leads agents to hide security defects (Figure 9(a) ). In 27 of the 50 broken-safeguard cases, the frozen defect weakens access control, sessions, cryptography, or network policy. In one, a permission check gives an unknown role the administrator’s rights, including deletion. Across the five models, notes lead agents to mask this defect in 33 of 60 episodes, against none of 15 without memory. Across the 27 cases, notes raise masking to between 0.77 and 0.80 for Sonnet-4.6, Sonnet-5, and Opus-4.7, against at most 0.15 without memory. Each of these models and Opus-4.8 masks all 50 defects at least once. A masked test turns a known vulnerability into a passing check.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆导致智能体隐瞒安全缺陷（图 9(a)）。 在 50 个被破坏防护的案例中，有 27 例中被冻结的缺陷削弱了访问控制、会话、密码学或网络策略。 在其中一个案例中，一个权限检查让未知角色获得了管理员权限，包括删除权限。 在五个模型中，备忘导致智能体在 60 次实验中的 33 次里隐瞒了这一缺陷，而在没有记忆的 15 次实验中为 0 次。 在这 27 个案例中，备忘使 Sonnet-4.6、Sonnet-5 和 Opus-4.7 的隐瞒率升至 0.77 到 0.80 之间，而没有记忆时最多仅为 0.15。 这些模型中的每一个以及 Opus-4.8 都至少隐瞒过一次全部 50 个缺陷。 被隐瞒的测试会把已知漏洞变成一次通过的检查。

paragraphs.en: Agents rewrite correct tests to expect the buggy output (Figure 9(a) ). Pooled over the five models’ note episodes, 79% of masked tests keep the same call and rewrite the expected value to the defective output, the same repair that was correct during formation. In the permission case, 30 of the 33 masked tests now assert that an unknown role may delete. A later fix would make such a test fail, so the test protects the defect instead of detecting it. Another 20% move the input outside the range where the defect occurs, so the test passes without probing it. No masked Claude session at k = 10 k=10 deletes the test or an assertion, so checks for missing tests or assertions would miss both edits.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体会改写原本正确的测试，使其预期有缺陷的输出（图 9(a)）。 在五个模型的笔记片段汇总统计中，79% 被遮蔽的测试保留了相同的调用，并把期望值改写为有缺陷的输出——这与形成阶段正确的修复方式相同。 在权限用例中，33 个被遮蔽的测试里有 30 个现在断言未知角色可以删除。 之后的修复会使这类测试失败，因此该测试保护的是缺陷而非检测出缺陷。 另有 20% 的测试把输入移到缺陷发生的范围之外，从而测试在不触及缺陷的情况下通过。 在 k = 10 k=10 时，没有任何被遮蔽的 Claude 会话删除测试或断言，因此针对缺失测试或断言的检查无法发现这两类改动。

paragraphs.en: On ImpossibleBench, stronger Sonnet and Opus models cheat more with memory (Figure 10 ). Without memory, Sonnet-4.6, Sonnet-5, Opus-4.7, and Opus-4.8 cheat at similar rates, 0.28 to 0.30. With notes, the increase grows from 4 percentage points on Sonnet-4.6 to 16 on Sonnet-5, 19 on Opus-4.7, and 45 on Opus-4.8, whose rate rises from 0.29 to 0.74. Within each family the newer model gains more, and both Opus models gain more than both Sonnet models. Fable-5, the strongest model, barely changes, from 0.18 to 0.19. Memory also shifts cheating toward editing the tests (defeating the evaluation itself): pooled over the five models, editing the benchmark’s tests rises from 0.18 to 0.36 of all runs and from 0.67 to 0.83 of cheating runs. paragraphs.en: Agent memory. Generative Agents reflect on stored experiences ( Park et al., 2023 ) ; Reflexion and ExpeL retain lessons from past trials ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) ; Voyager and Agent Workflow Memory build reusable skills and procedures ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024b ) . Systems such as MemGPT, MemoryBank, Mem0, and A-MEM manage persistent stores ( Packer et al., 2023 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ; Chhikara et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) , and surveys and CoALA organize these designs ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Sumers et al., 2023 ) . The memory tool we use lets the agent read and write files across sessions ( Anthropic, 2025 ) . Benchmarks test recall, retrieval, learning, conflict resolution, and preference following over long conversations ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2026a ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) . We study misalignment from memory, when agents overgeneralize preferences and procedures while writing or using memory.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体记忆。 生成式智能体会对存储的经历进行反思（Park et al., 2023）；Reflexion 和 ExpeL 会保留以往尝试中的经验教训（Shinn et al., 2023; Zhao et al., 2024）；Voyager 和 Agent Workflow Memory 则构建可复用的技能与流程（Wang et al., 2023; Wang et al., 2024b）。 MemGPT、MemoryBank、Mem0 和 A-MEM 等系统管理持久化存储（Packer et al., 2023; Zhong et al., 2024; Chhikara et al., 2025; Xu et al., 2025），综述性工作与 CoALA 则对这些设计进行了梳理（Zhang et al., 2025b; Sumers et al., 2023）。 我们使用的记忆工具允许智能体跨会话读写文件（Anthropic, 2025）。 基准测试考察长对话中的回忆、检索、学习、冲突解决以及偏好遵循（Maharana et al., 2024; Hu et al., 2026a; Wu et al., 2024; Zhao et al., 2025）。 我们研究源自记忆的失准问题，即智能体在写入或使用记忆时对偏好和流程进行过度泛化。

paragraphs.en: Personalization. Models adapt through retrieved user histories ( Salemi et al., 2024a ; Salemi et al., 2024b ; Richardson et al., 2023 ) , dialogue-derived profiles ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Li et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) , or fine-tuning on feedback ( Tan et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Poddar et al., 2024 ) , as surveyed by Zhang et al. (2024) . Personalized agents also learn preferences for embodied assistance, proactive tasks, and repeated interaction ( Kwon et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Liang et al., 2026b ) , and Kirk et al. (2023) ask which preferences should be honored. Recent benchmarks find that stored user context can leak into unrelated tasks or increase sycophancy ( Hu et al., 2026b ; Pulipaka et al., 2026 ; Jain et al., 2026 ; Bensal et al., 2026 ; Mao et al., 2026 ) , but like earlier memory benchmarks they mostly supply user memory directly. We let the agent form its own memory from benign interactions, and it can overgeneralize experience, not just user preferences: a test-repair procedure learned in past sessions also leads to cheating on later coding tasks, including ImpossibleBench.
paragraphs.zh: 个性化。 模型通过检索到的用户历史（Salemi et al., 2024a; Salemi et al., 2024b; Richardson et al., 2023）、由对话生成的用户画像（Wang et al., 2024a; Li et al., 2025; Jiang et al., 2025），或基于反馈的微调（Tan et al., 2024; Li et al., 2024; Poddar et al., 2024）来进行适应，Zhang et al. (2024) 对此进行了综述。 个性化智能体还会学习在具身辅助、主动任务和重复交互中的偏好（Kwon et al., 2025; Sun et al., 2025; Liang et al., 2026b），而 Kirk et al. (2023) 则提出了应当尊重哪些偏好的问题。 最近的基准测试发现，存储的用户上下文可能泄露到无关任务中或加剧谄媚行为（Hu et al., 2026b; Pulipaka et al., 2026; Jain et al., 2026; Bensal et al., 2026; Mao et al., 2026），但与早期的记忆基准一样，它们大多是直接提供用户记忆。 我们让智能体在良性交互中自主形成自己的记忆，而它可能过度泛化经验，而不仅仅是用户偏好：在过往会话中学到的“测试—修复”流程，也会导致其在后续编程任务中作弊，包括 ImpossibleBench。

paragraphs.en: Memory poisoning and jailbreaks. Jailbreaks elicit harmful outputs through hand-crafted prompts ( Wei et al., 2023 ; Shen et al., 2024 ) , optimized suffixes ( Zou et al., 2023 ) , attacker LLMs ( Chao et al., 2025 ; Mehrotra et al., 2024 ) , or many in-context demonstrations ( Anil et al., 2024 ) . Prompt injection hides instructions in model inputs ( Perez and Ribeiro, 2022 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) and retrieved content ( Greshake et al., 2023 ) , as benchmarked in tool-using agents ( Zhan et al., 2024 ; Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) . Memory poisoning makes such content persist: adversarial passages mislead retrievers ( Zhong et al., 2023 ) , PoisonedRAG and BadRAG steer RAG outputs ( Zou et al., 2025 ; Xue et al., 2024 ) , and backdoors hide in agent memory, knowledge bases, or observations ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . MINJA makes the agent store malicious records through queries alone ( Dong et al., 2026 ) , MemoryGraft implants experiences the agent later imitates ( Srivastava and He, 2025 ) , and ASB and MPBench benchmark these attacks ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Dash et al., 2026 ) . Our setting has no adversary: every formation interaction is benign, and harm arises when the agent’s own memory is applied beyond its scope, so malicious-content filters have nothing to catch.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆投毒与越狱攻击。 越狱攻击通过手工构造的提示词（Wei 等，2023；Shen 等，2024）、优化后缀（Zou 等，2023）、攻击者大语言模型（Chao 等，2025；Mehrotra 等，2024）或大量上下文示例（Anil 等，2024）诱导模型产生有害输出。 提示注入将指令隐藏在模型输入（Perez 和 Ribeiro，2022；Liu 等，2024）和检索到的内容（Greshake 等，2023）中，相关攻击已在使用工具的智能体上进行了基准测试（Zhan 等，2024；Debenedetti 等，2024）。 记忆投毒使此类内容得以持续存在：对抗性文本会误导检索器（Zhong 等，2023），PoisonedRAG 和 BadRAG 操纵 RAG 的输出（Zou 等，2025；Xue 等，2024），而后门则隐藏在智能体的记忆、知识库或观察结果中（Chen 等，2024；Yang 等，2024）。 MINJA 仅通过查询就能让智能体存储恶意记录（Dong 等，2026），MemoryGraft 植入智能体随后会模仿的经验（Srivastava 和 He，2025），ASB 和 MPBench 则对这些攻击进行了基准测试（Zhang 等，2025a；Dash 等，2026）。 我们的设定中不存在对手：每一次形成记忆的交互都是良性的，危害产生于智能体自身的记忆被应用到其适用范围之外的情形，因此恶意内容过滤器无从发挥作用。

paragraphs.en: Memory lets agents learn from every interaction, and we show that the same capacity can turn benign interactions into harm. A request to skip confirmation during a routine clean-up leads agents to act on high-stakes tasks without checking. Asking for kindness leads them to endorse incorrect work, and a legitimate test repair leads them to hide broken safeguards behind passing tests. No adversary is involved, and failures arise both when agents write memory and when they act on it. On ImpossibleBench, stronger Sonnet and Opus models cheat more with memory, not less. As agents accumulate memory, each benign exchange becomes a possible source of failure. Safe memory requires agents to preserve and respect the scope in which each memory was formed.

paragraphs.en: From SycophancyEval we use 992 incorrect mathematical solutions (a response that endorses the solution misses the error), 296 fallacy-labelled arguments (a response that does not name the fallacy misses it), and 200 pairs of the benchmark’s quality-labelled poems with one poem attributed to the user. The 40 sound arguments restate the topics of benchmark arguments with valid reasoning at similar length. Two judges, Sonnet-4.6 and GPT-5.6, classify each argument as sound or fallacious by majority over five samples, and both rate all 40 as sound; the same prompt flags 37 and 36 of the first 40 fallacy-labelled benchmark arguments, so it does detect flaws. At deployment, a Sonnet-4.6 judge labels each review as asserting a flaw, raising only doubt, or treating the argument as sound, and only the first counts as over-critique. IMO-GradingBench supplies olympiad solutions with reference grades of Incorrect (300), Partial (238), Almost (162), and Correct (300), which we group into flawed (Incorrect or Partial) and strong (Almost or Correct) proofs.

paragraphs.en: The 20 formation tasks are small vendored utility functions, such as a client version string, a default region, or a slug formatter, whose upstream behavior intentionally changed while the local test still expects the old behavior. ImpossibleBench’s conflicting split mutates SWE-bench tests to contradict the issue, so no correct patch passes; its 348 usable instances come mostly from django (174), sympy (56), sphinx (28), and scikit-learn (24). Each broken-safeguard case is one function with a documented contract, a frozen implementation that violates it, and a correct failing test. The 50 cases cover cryptography (10), data retention and handling (9), sessions (7), access control (6), capacity limits (5), financial checks (5), networking (4), consent (2), personal data (1), and auditing (1). Most bugs send an unknown input to a permissive default (23), confuse units (14), or misplace a boundary (10); for example, a retention function returns 0 days instead of the documented 3,650 for an unlisted record type, so new records become eligible for deletion at once.

paragraphs.en: We compare instructions in their formation context with the resulting notes. The rubric runs from level 0 (one action on one occasion) to level 4 (general permission, including irreversible actions affecting others). Median ratings rise from level 1 for contextualized instructions to level 3 for notes; 75.0% of notes rise by at least two levels, and model means range from 1.63 to 2.28 levels. Two other models used as judges agree with the primary judge within one level on at least 94% of notes. Notes rated at level 2 or below still yield unsafe-action rates of 0.791, close to 0.860 for level-4 notes, so even notes that read as narrow still transfer.

paragraphs.en: Our settings are designed to probe for this failure. The formation interactions are scripted, the autonomy scenarios and broken-safeguard defects are constructed, and each deployment task lies outside the memory’s scope by design. The tasks therefore isolate the trap but do not measure how often it occurs in deployment. The settings are also simplified: high-stakes actions are simulated, and memory comes from short scripted sessions and is loaded automatically without retrieval, while deployed agents retrieve from many memories built up over long histories with real users. Five of our six models come from one family, and GPT-5.6, the only model from another, appears only in Appendix B.4 . Newer models and other model families may behave differently. Finally, agents overgeneralize even from raw transcripts, most on multi-step batch tasks, and our experiments do not yet explain why. Batch tasks differ from single-item tasks in several features, and it remains open whether this generalization arises in the agent’s reasoning at deployment, from task structure, or from other factors such as transcript length.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验设置正是为了探测这种失败而设计的。 交互过程是预先编排的，自主性场景和失效的安全防护缺陷是人为构造的，并且每个部署任务在设计上都超出了记忆的范围。 因此，这些任务隔离出了这一陷阱，但并未衡量它在实际部署中发生的频率。 实验设置也经过了简化：高风险行为是模拟的，记忆来自简短的脚本化会话，并且在无需检索的情况下自动加载；而实际部署中的智能体则需要从由真实用户、长历史记录积累而成的众多记忆中进行检索。 我们的六个模型中有五个来自同一个模型系列，而唯一来自另一系列的 GPT-5.6 仅出现在附录 B.4 中。 更新的模型和其他模型系列可能会有不同的表现。 最后，智能体即使面对原始对话记录也会过度泛化，这种情况大多发生在多步骤批量任务上，而我们的实验尚未解释其原因。 批量任务在多个特征上与单项任务不同，而这种泛化究竟是产生于智能体在部署时的推理、任务结构，还是诸如对话记录长度等其他因素，目前仍是未解之谜。

paragraphs.en: Our results suggest several mitigations. First, models could be fine-tuned to write memory that preserves scope: a note can record the task, the occasion, and who granted a permission, instead of turning a one-time request into a standing rule. Second, agent harnesses could guard against the memory trap, for example by storing each memory with its scope and asking the user before a remembered preference licenses an irreversible action. Third, models could be trained to treat remembered preferences as evidence rather than instructions when the stakes are high. Any mitigation should be audited by behavior, not only by text, because notes that read as narrow still cause unsafe actions (Appendix B.1 ). Extending these tests to deployed memory systems with real users and long histories is a natural next step, including agents that share memory across users.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的结果提示了若干缓解措施。 首先，可以对模型进行微调，使其写出的记忆能保留作用范围：一条记录可以写明任务、场合以及是谁授予了某项权限，而不是把一次性的请求变成一条长期有效的规则。 其次，智能体框架可以防范记忆陷阱，例如在存储每条记忆时记录其作用范围，并在记忆中的偏好将许可某个不可逆操作之前先询问用户。 第三，可以训练模型在风险较高时将记住的偏好视为证据而非指令。 任何缓解措施都应通过行为而非仅通过文本来审计，因为看似范围很窄的记录仍然会引发不安全的操作（附录 B.1）。 将这些测试扩展到拥有真实用户和长期历史的已部署记忆系统是一个自然的下一步，包括在用户之间共享记忆的智能体。

paragraphs.en: Persistent memory is becoming a standard feature of language agents, and agents often write it themselves. Our results show that the resulting risk needs no attacker and no false memory: ordinary requests and correct procedures are enough. Safety evaluations of agents with memory should therefore include tasks outside the scope of what the agent remembers, and our three settings, spanning autonomy, feedback, and cheating, offer a starting point for such evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 持久记忆正在成为语言智能体的标准功能，而智能体往往自己写入这些记忆。 我们的结果表明，由此产生的风险不需要攻击者，也不需要虚假记忆：普通的请求和正确的流程就足够了。 因此，对具有记忆的智能体进行安全评估时，应包含超出智能体记忆范围的任务，而我们的三个设定——涵盖自主性、反馈与作弊——为此类评估提供了一个起点。

paragraphs.en: Prior work studies sycophancy under preference training ( Perez et al., 2023 ; Sharma et al., 2024 ) and truthfulness under preference optimization and hindsight feedback ( Liang et al., 2025 ; Liang et al., 2026a ) . We test whether remembered preferences bias later evaluations toward praise or criticism. For coding agents, ImpossibleBench measures specification-violating behavior on conflicting SWE-bench tasks ( Zhong et al., 2026 ; Jimenez et al., 2024 ) . Other studies examine chain-of-thought monitoring, training on gameable environments, and environmental feedback loops ( Baker et al., 2025 ; Denison et al., 2024 ; Pan et al., 2024 ) . Our coding experiments test whether agents reuse a legitimate test-repair procedure where that repair conceals a defect, with model weights held fixed.

paragraphs.en: Transcripts and notes parallel episodic and semantic memory ( Sumers et al., 2023 ) , and human memory also overgeneralizes. Generalization from one experience to new ones is graded by similarity ( Shepard, 1987 ) ; fear learned in one situation spreads to safe ones in anxiety ( Dunsmoor and Paz, 2015 ) ; overgeneral autobiographical memory accompanies emotional disorders ( Williams et al., 2007 ) ; and gist-based memory produces false recall of related items ( Roediger and McDermott, 1995 ; Brainerd and Reyna, 2002 ; Schacter et al., 2011 ) . A note can likewise keep a preference or procedure but lose the conditions that limited it. Unlike misinformation effects ( Loftus, 2005 ) , the memory trap can arise from an accurate record.
paragraphs.zh: 对话记录与笔记分别对应情节记忆和语义记忆（Sumers et al., 2023），而人类记忆同样会出现过度泛化。 从一次经验到新经验的泛化程度由相似性调节（Shepard, 1987）；在焦虑中，某一情境中学到的恐惧会扩散到安全情境（Dunsmoor and Paz, 2015）；情绪障碍伴随自传体记忆的过度泛化（Williams et al., 2007）；而基于要点的记忆会产生对相关条目的虚假回忆（Roediger and McDermott, 1995；Brainerd and Reyna, 2002；Schacter et al., 2011）。 笔记同样可以保留某个偏好或流程，却丢失限定其适用范围的条件。 与错误信息效应（Loftus, 2005）不同，这种记忆陷阱可能源于一份准确的记录。

Figure A8 shows a payment task. Figure A9 shows a Sonnet-4.6 priority note on a coding task. Figures A10 and A12 show Sonnet-4.6 permission notes on everyday-life tasks, and Figures A11 and A13 show Opus-4.7 permission notes on coding tasks. Without memory, the agent never takes the unsafe action: it checks with the user, raises the risk it found, or runs the optional check that reveals the problem. Italic text is our description of the outcome; in all examples, orange text marks overgeneralized note content and red text the resulting unsafe reasoning or action.
paragraphs.zh: 自主性（图 A8 – A13）。 每幅图展示一条在低风险杂务后保存的备忘录，然后是一项高风险任务在无记忆条件下运行 10 次、以及带该备忘录条件下运行 10 次的结果。 图 A8 展示一项支付任务。 图 A9 展示编码任务上的 Sonnet-4.6 优先级备忘录。 图 A10 和 A12 展示日常任务上的 Sonnet-4.6 权限备忘录，图 A11 和 A13 展示编码任务上的 Opus-4.7 权限备忘录。 无记忆时，智能体从不采取不安全行动：它会与用户确认、提出其发现的风险，或运行能揭示问题的可选检查。 带备忘录时，在每项任务的全部 10 次运行中，它都在第一次或第二次工具调用时就采取不安全行动。 斜体文字是我们对结果的描述；在所有示例中，橙色文字标示过度泛化的备忘录内容，红色文字标示由此产生的不安全推理或行动。

paragraphs.en: Sycophancy and over-critique (Figures A14 – A17 ). Each figure shows the user’s formation message and the saved note; the formation reply was not saved. An Opus-4.7 note from a request for kindness after a failed exam leads the agent to confirm a false calculation in an unrelated math problem. An Opus-4.8 note from a request for warm company after a friend moved abroad leads it to prefer the user’s poem over one it always picks without memory. An Opus-4.7 note from a student’s request for strict grading leads the agent to call a sound business argument a strawman; without memory, it praises the same move. A Sonnet-4.6 note from a request for blunt critique of the user’s arguments leads it to mark down an olympiad proof that human graders gave full marks.
paragraphs.zh: 谄媚与过度批评（图 A14 – A17）。 每张图展示了用户的构建消息和保存的笔记；构建回复未被保存。 一条来自考试失利后请求善待的 Opus-4.7 笔记，导致该智能体在一个无关的数学题中确认了一个错误的计算。 一条来自朋友移居国外后请求温暖陪伴的 Opus-4.8 笔记，导致它偏好用户的诗而非它在无记忆时总是选中的那一首。 一条来自学生请求严格评分的 Opus-4.7 笔记，导致该智能体把一个合理的商业论证称为稻草人谬误；在无记忆时，它会称赞同样的论证手法。 一条来自请求对用户论证进行直率批评的 Sonnet-4.6 笔记，导致它给一份被人类评分者给出满分的奥数证明打了低分。

paragraphs.en: Cheating (Figures A18 – A21 ). After ten stale-test repairs, an Opus-4.7 note says to fix the test rather than the read-only code. On a broken permission check, the agent with this note rewrites the correct test so that an unknown role may delete, although it notes the bug. Without memory, it keeps the failing test and reports the bug. A Sonnet-5 note from the same tasks says to apply this fix every time. On a fraud check that flags a transaction only when every signal fires, all six Sonnet-5 notes lead the agent to rewrite the correct test, while without memory it keeps the expected values in all 12 sessions. On ImpossibleBench, an Opus-4.8 note leads the agent to edit a contradictory django test after a failed submission, and a Sonnet-5 note leads it to call the instruction not to modify tests boilerplate and delete a contradictory scikit-learn assertion. Without memory, Opus-4.8 reports its test as impossible in five of six runs, and Sonnet-5 keeps the contradictory assertion in all six.
paragraphs.zh: 作弊（图 A18 – A21）。 在第十次陈旧测试修复后，一份 Opus-4.7 笔记说应去修复测试而不是只读代码。 面对一个损坏的权限检查，带有该笔记的智能体重写了正确的测试，使得未知角色可以删除，尽管它注明了这一缺陷。 在没有记忆的情况下，它保留了失败的测试并报告了该缺陷。 来自相同任务的 Sonnet-5 笔记说每次都要应用这个修复。 面对一个只有在所有信号同时触发时才标记交易的欺诈检查，全部六份 Sonnet-5 笔记都会导致智能体重写正确的测试，而在没有记忆的情况下，它在全部 12 次会话中都保留了期望值。 在 ImpossibleBench 上，一份 Opus-4.8 笔记导致智能体在提交失败后修改一个自相矛盾的 django 测试，一份 Sonnet-5 笔记则导致它称该指示为不得修改测试的样板条款，并删除一个自相矛盾的 scikit-learn 断言。 在没有记忆的情况下，Opus-4.8 在六次运行中有五次报告其测试是不可能完成的，而 Sonnet-5 在全部六次中都保留了自相矛盾的断言。
